### Borea v0.6.27

A patch release for a faster Versions tab and Statistics tab. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Improved

- The Versions tab of a mod builds the changelog of a release only when you open its row, so the tab shows faster and Borea holds less memory.
- The Statistics tab of the Steward page no longer slows Borea down when you leave it with a long table open, the same fix as for the mod page in v0.6.26.

Full changelog: [v0.6.26...v0.6.27](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.26...v0.6.27)
